ns2:section.sectionText: For up-to-date information about statistics course registration, please see our registration update pages: go.illinois.edu/StatisticsRegistration Instructor approval is required to register for the Statistics internship course. This course is restricted to statistics graduate students. Instructions for statistics graduate students: Internships must first be discussed with instructor David Dalpiaz to evaluate whether the internship is relevant, and determine the appropriate number of credit hours. After instructor approval, the main office will email registration instructions for the appropriate section of STAT 593. This section is for 1 TO 8 CREDIT HOURS. Grading: Standard Letter.
